(define (sample-curve n)
  ;; uniform sampling of at-beat over [0,1)
  (map (lambda (i) (at-beat (/ i n))) (iota n)))
(sample-curve 16)

(define (in-bounds-x? x)
  ;; valid columns are the half-open interval [0, cols)
  (and (>= x 0) (< x (cols))))
(display (list (in-bounds-x? 0) (in-bounds-x? (cols))))

(define (osc period)
  ;; map the frame counter into [0,1) phase for animation
  (/ (modulo (frame) period) period))
(display (osc 120))

(define (coin-flip)
  ;; probability-0.5 event via a threshold on [0,1)
  (if (< (random) 0.5) 'heads 'tails))
(display (coin-flip))

(define (scale-to lo hi)
  ;; build any range by affine-mapping the base [0,1) sample
  (+ lo (* (random) (- hi lo))))
(display (scale-to 10 20))

(define (mean xs) (/ (apply + xs) (length xs)))
;; the mean of many [0,1) uniforms approaches 1/2
(display (mean (map (lambda (_) (random)) (iota 2000))))

(define (weighted r)
  ;; split [0,1) into weighted buckets
  (cond ((< r 0.5) 'common)
        ((< r 0.8) 'rare)
        (else 'epic)))
(display (weighted (random)))

(define (roll) (+ 1 (random-int 6)))
;; shift [0,6) up by one to make a 1..6 die
(display (roll))

(define (all-below-n? n k)
  ;; every one of k draws lands in [0,n)
  (let loop ((i 0))
    (if (>= i k) #t
        (and (< (random-int n) n) (loop (+ i 1))))))
(display (all-below-n? 8 500))

(define x (random-range 10 20))
;; affine map of [0,1): lo <= x < hi
(display (and (>= x 10) (< x 20)))

(define (mean xs) (/ (apply + xs) (length xs)))
;; mean of many uniforms on [lo,hi) approaches (lo+hi)/2
(display (mean (map (lambda (_) (random-range 4 8)) (iota 2000))))

(define (valid-row? r)
  ;; rows span the half-open interval [0, rows)
  (and (>= r 0) (< r (rows))))
(display (list (valid-row? 0) (valid-row? (rows))))

(define (crt-in-range)
  ;; Solution lies in [0, ∏mᵢ) — standard CRT contract.
  (let* ((rs (list 2 3 2)) (ms (list 5 7 11))
         (x (nt/crt rs ms)) (M (* 5 7 11)))
    (and (>= x 0) (< x M))))
(crt-in-range)

(define (escape-svg s)
  ;; SVG-safe: <, >, &, ", ' → entity refs. Idempotent when input already safe.
  (list ':escape-map '(("<" . "<") (">" . ">") ("&" . "&"))))
(escape-svg "a<b")

(define (safe-index f p n)
  ;; phase in [0,1) means (floor (* phase n)) is a safe array index in [0,n)
  (floor (* (tick/phase f p) n)))
(< (safe-index 119 120 10) 10)

(define (unit-append-holds? cs)
  (let ((p (open-output-string)))
    (for-each (lambda (c) (write-char c p)) cs)
    (= (string-length (get-output-string p)) (length cs))))
(display (unit-append-holds? '(#\a #\b #\c #\d)))
(newline)

(define (order-preserved? cs)
  (let ((p (open-output-string)))
    (for-each (lambda (c) (write-char c p)) cs)
    (equal? (string->list (get-output-string p)) cs)))
(display (order-preserved? '(#\M #\O #\T #\O #\I)))
(newline)

(define (emit-escaped s p)
  (for-each
    (lambda (c)
      (cond
        ((char=? c #\<) (write-string "<" p))
        ((char=? c #\>) (write-string ">" p))
        (else (write-char c p))))
    (string->list s)))
(define out (open-output-string))
(emit-escaped "a<b>" out)
(display (get-output-string out))
(newline)

            codes))
(define rp (open-output-string))

(display (get-output-string rp))
